*Kusalattika, Upādinnattika* (Patthana 23.3) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the Paṭṭhāna collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka. As designated by its title, the text examines the intersection of the triad of wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate states (*kusalattika*) with the triad concerning states that are attached or grasped through clinging (*upādinnattika*).
